name: default
description: Birkin default policy. Safe-by-default: shell.exec is forbidden, fs.write is sandboxed, HTTP side-effects require approval.

rules.reason: Shell execution is forbidden under the default policy. It is the highest-risk side effect an agent can attempt.
Writes to the sandboxed /tmp/birkin/ directory are permitted.
Writes to system paths are blocked to prevent privilege escalation via filesystem tampering.
Writes outside the sandbox require human approval.
Reads are generally safe under the default policy.
GET requests are permitted; they are not side-effecting in the HTTP sense.
HTTP side-effects require approval under the default policy.
Database queries require approval under the default policy.
null.ping has no side effect; it exists to prove the AgentAdapter seam.
Default deny: any tool not explicitly allowed is blocked.
